newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot opens three new domestic routes.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot opens three new domestic routes.

text.p: Russian flagship carrier Aeroflot will begin daily scheduled flights between Moscow and Vladivostok from July 29, a company spokesman said on Friday.
"We will operate an Ilyushin Il-62M jet with three classes of service on the route," the spokesman told Reuters. He added that Aeroflot hoped to open an office in Vladivostok soon.
Transaero and Domodedovo Airlines currently account for most traffic between Moscow and the Far Eastern port, following the suspension of flights by Orient-Avia on July 10.
The Aeroflot spokesman said the company also planned a regular passenger service between Moscow and Kaliningrad, the Russian enclave on the Baltic Sea, from August 4.
"We will run flights twice weekly operating Tupolev Tu-134 jets," he said. Also in August, Aeroflot may begin flights from Moscow to Arkhangelsk in the Russian Arctic three times a week.
